title: The Great Sock Drawer Reckoning
skyStory: The moon has slipped into Virgo, still ninety-three percent bright but starting to wane, and Virgo has arrived with a label maker and a very specific vision. Virgo cannot see a crooked thing without straightening it. Virgo has alphabetised the stars. Saturn is weeping with joy. Mars has hidden his sock drawer, knowing exactly what comes next.

reading: The waning moon in Virgo is the universe's way of saying tidy up after the big show. Pick one small, contained space, a drawer, a shelf, the cabin's junk basket, and sort it with total focus. You will find something you forgot you had, and it will be weirdly useful.

The [[Knight of Pentacles]] plods beside you today, slow and thorough. Usually you would race him. Today, walk at his pace. Around 2:40 pm you will find the tiny thing you have been looking for since autumn. You will say aha out loud. Nobody will hear. That is fine.
joel.mission: Sort one drawer completely, and keep the single weirdest object you find on your desk all week.
joel.omen: A perfectly straight row of icicles. It means order is coming to something that felt chaotic.

reading: Virgo is your fellow earth sign, and today it lends you its magnifying glass. The Wood Rat was already the best detail-spotter in any room, and now it is practically supernatural. You will catch a mistake before anyone else, and fix it so quietly no one will ever know.

Your helpful streak is strong today. Somebody will ask you for a hand, and you will give it, but here is the twist: ask for one small thing back. An opinion, a favour, a cup of tea. The [[Six of Pentacles]] goes in both directions, and today you practise the receiving side.
nancy.mission: Help someone with something today, then ask them for one small thing in return, out loud, without apologising.
nancy.omen: A perfectly folded towel or napkin. It means your careful work is about to be appreciated.

together.text: Each of you tidies one tiny space today, five minutes only, and sends before and after photos. The after photos must be suspiciously dramatic, with moody lighting and a caption. Virgo will judge neatness. Leo, still hanging around, will judge the presentation.
